title: evokit v0 proposal input
description: A falsifiable proposal: exactly these five fields, no others.

targets.description: Editable file paths, relative with forward slashes, covering every file the candidate changes, for example ["prompts/guide.txt"].

mechanism.description: The general mechanism the change applies, in one or two sentences.

predicted_effect.description: Predicted paired net score change on the selection split, in summed per-task score units, for example 3.

falsification.description: The measured result that would show the proposal is wrong, for example 'net <= 0'.

prior.description: Link to an earlier attempt of the same idea, if any.

attempt.description: Id of an earlier proposal this one revisits, or null for a first attempt.

difference.description: What differs from the prior attempt, or why this is the first.
